{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek API quota (balance) widget for the DSH web GUI: a floating bottom-right card showing remaining DeepSeek API balance.","id":"gh:1333807388","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-deepseek-quota","slug":"yingjunnan/dsh-deepseek-quota","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek API quota (balance) widget for the DSH web GUI: a floating bottom-right card showing remain"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ing DeepSeek API balance."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-deepseek-quota"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **web GUI** plugin: shows your remaining **DeepSeek API quota (balance)** a"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"nd **today's consumption** in a floating card pinned to the **bottom-right corner** of the page."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> `中文文档在前，英文说明见下文。` / Chinese docs first, English below."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"# 中文说明"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"一个给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**网页界面**用的插件：在页面**右下角**悬浮显示你的 **DeepSeek API 额度（余额）** 与 **今日消费**。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- 右下角悬浮卡片（注册在框架级 `shell.overlay` 槽位，纯叠加、不遮挡应用）。
- 显示**总余额**、可用状态、**当前对话费用**、**今日已消费**、**赠送余额**与**充值余"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"额**。
- **当前对话费用**：宿主侧对每条 `assistant/message` 按官方价格表计价（含 2026-08-17 起峰谷定价；定价引擎移植自 dsh-web-billing，MIT"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"），通过 `GET /api/deepseek-session-cost?sessionId=<id>` 返回当前会话累计费用——按持久化日志全量回放，包含安装前（重启前）的历史。把鼠标放到费用后面的"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"**圆圈叹号 ⓘ** 上，会显示代入真实数值的计算公式（输入/缓存命中/输出 tokens × 单价 = 小计，单价为加权有效价 ¥/M）。
- 余额每 60 秒自动刷新、对话费用每 5 秒刷新，也可"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"手动刷新。
- **峰谷时段提示**：显示当前处于 DeepSeek 的**高峰**（工作日 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00，北京时间）还是**空闲**时段（2026-08-17 "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"起；**周六、周日全天空闲**），让你知道现在跑模型更贵还是更便宜；随余额每 60 秒刷新。
- **可折叠为小钱包图标**：点卡头右下角的箭头即可把卡片收成右下角的一个**小钱包图标**（点击可展开"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"）；折叠态下钱包图标会以颜色标识当前峰谷（高峰=红、空闲=绿、常规=灰）或错误状态，颜色随余额每 60 秒刷新。
- 自动跟随应用浅色/深色主题（使用 `--dsw-*` 设计变量）。
- 明确的错误"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"状态：未配置 Key、网络失败、接口报错等。
- API Key 不出本机：浏览器只访问本地路由（由宿主侧注册）。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"需要 pnpm。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"该包声明了 `dsh.bundle`，`dsh plugin` 会自动把它加进 profile 的 bundle 层（无需手动改配置）。之后："},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. 重启网页应用：`dsh web`（若无 dsh CLI，用 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`；bundle 层在启动时读取）。
2. 打开 http://127.0.0.1:"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"3080 并刷新页面。
3. 右下角即出现额度卡片。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> 手动方式：把包放进 profile 的 `node_modules`，并在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中加一条：
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 配置"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"插件读取的正是 harness 自己在用的那个 Key：`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`（通过凭证服务解析；在 **设置 → 模型** 页面填写，存于 `~/.dsh/.credentials.y"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"自己在用的那个 Key：`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`（通过凭证服务解析；在 **设置 → 模型** 页面填写，存于 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，或在启动环境中导出）。"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 今日消费（`今日已消费`）"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DeepSeek 官方 API 没有开放用量查询接口，所以插件按优先级使用两种来源："},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. **官方数据（优先）**——与平台控制台相同的可按日期筛选的数据。需要配置可选的平台会话令牌："},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"配置后，宿主侧调用 `platform.deepseek.com/api/v0/usage/cost?month=&year=` 并取"今天"那一行。卡片显示 `今日已消费 ¥X.XX`。"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"2. **估算（兜底）**——未配置令牌时，宿主侧按余额差值估算（`max(0, 当天期初余额 − 当前余额)`，状态存于 `~/.dsh/storages/deepseek-quota-day.js"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"on`）。卡片显示 `今日约消费 ≈¥X.XX`，避免被误认为官方数字。"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"无需其它配置。"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Bottom-right overlay card (registered into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot — additive, never b"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"locks the app).
- Shows **total balance**, availability, **current conversation cost**, **today's co"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"nsumption**, and the **granted** / **topped-up** balance.
- **Current conversation cost** (`当前对话费用`)"},{"id":"p25s4","text":": the host prices every `assistant/message` with the official DeepSeek price table (incl. peak/off-p"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"eak since 2026-08-17; pricing engine ported from dsh-web-billing, MIT) and reports the current sessi"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"on's accumulated cost via `GET /api/deepseek-session-cost?sessionId=<id>` — the whole conversation i"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"s replayed from its persisted log, so the figure includes history from before the plugin was install"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"ed. Hover the circled **ⓘ** next to the value to see the live formula with real numbers (`输入/缓存命中/输出"},{"id":"p25s9","text":" tokens × 单价 = 小计`, with the effective blended ¥/M rate).
- Auto-refreshes every 60 s (balance) / 5 "},{"id":"p25s10","text":"s (conversation cost), plus a manual refresh button.
- **Peak/off-peak indicator** (`峰谷时段提示`): shows"},{"id":"p25s11","text":" whether the current time falls in DeepSeek's **peak** (`高峰`), **off-peak** (`空闲`), or **flat** (`常规"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"`) pricing window (weekdays 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00 Beijing time since 2026-08-17; **weekends are "},{"id":"p25s13","text":"off-peak all day**), so you can tell when a run will cost more or less. Refreshes with the balance ("},{"id":"p25s14","text":"60 s).
- **Collapsible to a small wallet icon**: click the chevron in the card header to collapse th"},{"id":"p25s15","text":"e card into a small **wallet icon** at the bottom-right (click to expand); in the collapsed state th"},{"id":"p25s16","text":"e icon is tinted by the current peak/off-peak state (peak = red, off-peak = green, flat = gray) or t"},{"id":"p25s17","text":"he error state, refreshed with the balance (60 s).
- Follows the app's light/dark theme (`--dsw-*` t"},{"id":"p25s18","text":"okens).
- Explicit error states: missing API key, network failure, provider errors.
- The API key ne"},{"id":"p25s19","text":"ver leaves your machine — the browser only talks to local routes that the host half registers."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Part | File | What it does |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Host half | `lib/index.js` | Cordis plugin (`inject: credentials, webServer`) registering `GET /ap"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"i/deepseek-balance` (balance + today's consumption + the current peak/off-peak pricing period) and `"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"GET /api/deepseek-session-cost?sessionId=<id>` (current conversation cost); subscribes `session/even"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"t` to price every `assistant/message`. |
| Pricing | `lib/pricing.js` | Official DeepSeek price-tabl"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"e engine (policy timeline + peak/off-peak, weekends off-peak all day), ported from dsh-web-billing ("},{"id":"p28s6","text":"MIT). |
| Browser half | `lib/client.js` | `dsh.client` web bundle registering the widget into `shel"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"l.overlay`; polls balance every 60 s (incl. the peak/off-peak badge) and the current session's cost "},{"id":"p28s8","text":"every 5 s. |
| Composition | `cordis.patch.yml` | The `dsh.bundle` patch layer that inserts the load"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"|
